reason: The first harness used one binary64 endpoint for both cells adjacent to an exact rational partition boundary. PARTITION_PLAN.json specifies a separately downward-rounded lower endpoint and upward-rounded upper endpoint, so the boxes were not bit-exact.
fix: Represent x_lo/x_hi and y_lo/y_hi for every cell separately and validate all 32 box_hex records against PARTITION_PLAN.json before accepting timing.
